new_draw_failure: Unsupported source constant / inverse source color blending with separate alpha factors
findings: The v225 unsigned-shift/OR implementation removes the shader-creation rejection. Notepad still has no editor text, although its title and status reflect the typing. Three indexed instanced draw rejections with E_INVALIDARG are recorded before worker submission.

The complete failed draw contains the now-supported 146-word shader, a 524288-byte glyph buffer, a 1024 by 20 palette, instanced geometry, RGB write mask 7, and a 756 by 406 target. Source color and alpha factors are BLEND_FACTOR; destination RGB is INV_SRC_COLOR and destination alpha is INV_SRC_ALPHA. The constant is black with alpha one.

The blend contract admits only its existing Porter-Duff factor pairs and rejects this component coverage equation. The unchanged v225 CPU replay also rejects the captured state before execution. A new implementation is required; this report does not claim it passes.

Typing, maximize and close gates are not passed. The controller restores topology, removes both owned guest devices and revokes input. The same text appears correctly after ordinary display restoration. The owned test document is then cleared and closed.

All 906 successful worker requests have matching acknowledgements. Their full ordered prefix and all 39 guest archive members are preserved and hash-verified. There is no logged NPU device-loss or queue failure. Worker socket-close exit 1 is retained as cleanup evidence.

After cleanup, a stronger independent packed-lookup test changes the palette to 1024 distinct colors and verifies 4096 exact NPU pixels. It samples 762 indices spanning all upper two-bit values. This does not remedy the separate blend rejection.

A read-only simulation of v118 finds 460 complete-pipeline misses and 2409 model setup calls. Doubling triangle/uniform cache capacities predicts 277 misses with FIFO. This is not measured speed or queue safety; the initial mismatch from a lazily compiled crop-origin model and the corrected analysis are both retained.
Full desktop offload, usable speed, physical Delta display migration and a Tahoma benefit remain unfinished.
